questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow (s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some tickets are clocks.

All buttons are tickets.

No stamps are clocks.

**Conclusions:**

(I) No tickets are stamps.

(II) Some buttons are clocks.
questions.solution:
Statements:

Some tickets are clocks.

All buttons are tickets.

No stamps are clocks.

The Venn diagram as per the given statements:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/21b8cbded92785fd2845d8a37eb0c6dfd1a9697a6c0b2a0dbd4103af41e2c8bc.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) No tickets are stamps. → **Not follow **( There is no direct relation given between tickets and stamps so it can be possible but not definitely true)

(II) Some buttons are clocks. → **Not follow** (There is no direct relation given between buttons and clocks so it can be possible but not definitely true)

Hence, the correct answer is** "Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows".**

questions.question:
What will come in the place of the question mark (?) in the following equation if '+' and '-' are interchanged and '×' and '÷' are interchanged?

35 - 28 ÷ 7 + 322 × 23 = ?
questions.solution:
Here, we use the BODMAS table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/784b90b54b9f26832ca7194db9e5f493ad1ce0f1e8af95a0c85fff0f49af3e51.png] 

Given:

⇒ 35 - 28 ÷ 7 + 322 × 23

After interchanging '+' and '-' & '×' and '÷' →

⇒ 35 + 28 × 7 - 322 ÷ 23

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 35 + 28 × 7 - __**322 ÷ 23**__

⇒ 35 + __**28 × 7**__ - 14

⇒ 35 + 196 - 14

⇒ 231 - 14 = **217**

**⇒ '35 + 28 × 7 - 322 ÷ 23 = 217'**

Here, the value of the equation is '217'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (1)".

questions.question:
What will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation if '+' and '-' are interchanged and '×' and '÷' are interchanged?

8 ÷ 512 × 64 + 33 - 95 = ?
questions.solution:
Here, we use the BODMAS table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/784b90b54b9f26832ca7194db9e5f493ad1ce0f1e8af95a0c85fff0f49af3e51.png] 

Given:

⇒ 8 ÷ 512 × 64 + 33 - 95

After interchanging '+' and '-' & '×' and '÷' →

⇒ 8 × 512 ÷ 64 - 33 + 95

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 8 × __**512 **____**÷**____** 64**__ - 33 + 95

⇒ __**8 × 8**__ - 33 + 95

⇒ 64 - 33 + 95 

⇒ 159 - 33 = **126**

**⇒ '8 × 512 ÷ 64 - 33 + 95 = 126'**

Here, the value of the equation is **'126'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (4)".

questions.question: 23 is related to 74 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 13 is related to 44 . To which of the following is 18 related to, following the same logic?
questions.solution:
**Logic: Second no. = [(First no. × 3) + 5]**

23 is related to 74 →

​⇒ [(23 × 3) + 5]

​⇒ (69 + 5) = 74

13 is related to 44 →

​⇒ [(13 × 3) + 5]

​⇒ (39 + 5) = 44

Similarly, '18' will be related to:

​⇒ [(18 × 3) + 5]

​⇒ (54 + 5) = **59**

Here, '18' is related to** '59'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (3)".

questions.question:
What will come in the place of the question mark (?) in the following equation if '+' and '-' are interchanged and '×' and '÷' are interchanged?

24 + 4 - 9 × 3 ÷ 6 = ?
questions.solution:
Here, we use the BODMAS table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/784b90b54b9f26832ca7194db9e5f493ad1ce0f1e8af95a0c85fff0f49af3e51.png] 

Given:

⇒ 24 + 4 - 9 × 3 ÷ 6

After interchanging '+' and '-' & '×' and '÷' →

⇒ 24 - 4 + 9 ÷ 3 × 6

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 24 - 4 + __**9 **____**÷**____** 3**__ × 6

⇒ 24 - 4 + __**3 × 6**__

⇒ 24 - 4 + 18

⇒ 42 - 4 = 38

**⇒ '24 - 4 + 9 ÷ 3 × 6 = 38'**

Here, the value of the equation is **'38'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (1)".
